svg.title: Daily posts: 30-day running average
svg.desc: Trailing 30-day recovered-sample measures, not total posting activity. Incomplete calendar windows are unavailable, not zero.

g.font-family: DejaVu Serif, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
g.text: Source: recovered-corpus metadata; lower bounds, not total activity. Each window includes the shown
date and previous 29 Shanghai days. Daily mean = recovered posts / 30. First 29 days and windows
crossing unrequested/partial days are unavailable, not zero. Distinct publisher/brand groups are not
necessarily independent U.S. newsrooms. Requested window ends 24 Oct 2026.
